description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pahala Katuneriya, Naththandiya D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410488 (22/0843)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in Puttalam District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, owners, extents, encumbrances, and property rights - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
